source.author: prop
source.text: curia, praetexto quae nunc nitet alta senatu, pellitos habuit, rustica corda, Patres.
source.text_original: curia, praetexto quae nunc nitet alta senatu, / pellitos habuit, rustica corda, Patres.
source.text_english: The senate house, which now shines high with senators in the toga praetexta, once had fur-clad Fathers, men with rustic hearts.

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: curia, praetexto nunc quae nitet alta senatu, pellitos habuit, rustica corda, patres .
reuse.text_original: curia, praetexto nunc quae nitet alta senatu, pellitos habuit, rustica corda, patres .
reuse.text_english: The senate-house, which now shines aloft under the pretext of the Senate, once had senators clothed in skins, men of rustic hearts.
